name: Lindy AI
tagline: Capable AI agent builder — but closed-source and cloud-only with usage-based pricing
painPoints: Lindy is closed-source and cloud-only — no self-hosted option for teams with data privacy requirements or infrastructure preferences
Pricing scales with usage and agent runs, making costs unpredictable as you automate more workflows
Building effective Lindies requires meaningful prompt engineering and workflow configuration — not truly zero-setup
Email and calendar integrations exist but the primary use case is general-purpose agent building, not deep inbox or scheduling intelligence
No source-available community, no public roadmap transparency, and no ability to audit or extend the core platform
metaTitle: Lindy AI Alternative: Self-Hostable With Flat Pricing
metaDescription: Lindy AI is cloud-only with usage-based pricing. GAIA is source-available, self-hostable, and Pro is a flat ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month. Compare agents and pricing.
whyPeopleLook: Lindy AI is a polished AI agent platform, but users seeking alternatives typically cite three concerns: the closed-source nature prevents self-hosting or auditing, usage-based pricing creates budget uncertainty as automation scales, and Lindy's general-purpose agent approach means email and calendar integrations are broad rather than deeply specialized. Users who want a Lindy-style AI with source-available transparency and predictable pricing land on GAIA.

faqs.question: Is GAIA source-available unlike Lindy AI?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) and self-hostable via Docker. Lindy AI is a proprietary closed-source product with no self-hosted option.

faqs.question: How does GAIA's pricing compare to Lindy AI?
faqs.answer: Lindy charges based on usage and agent runs, which scales unpredictably. GAIA Pro is a flat ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month regardless of how many automations you run. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Can GAIA build custom agents like Lindy?
faqs.answer: GAIA provides a proactive AI assistant with configurable workflows and your other tool integrations via MCP — covering the personal productivity use cases most Lindies are built for. It does not offer Lindy's visual agent builder for arbitrary enterprise workflow automation.

faqs.question: Who should choose GAIA over Lindy AI?
faqs.answer: GAIA is the better fit for individuals and small teams who want source-available transparency, self-hosting control (free for personal use; for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license from the GAIA team), predictable pricing, and deeper email + calendar intelligence. Lindy is better for teams needing a no-code visual builder for complex multi-system enterprise automations.

faqs.question: Who are Lindy AI's main competitors?
faqs.answer: Lindy AI's main competitors are AI agent and automation platforms such as Zapier Agents, Make, n8n and Relevance AI, and AI assistants such as GAIA. The platforms suit teams that want to build agents step by step. GAIA suits people who want one assistant that already works across email, calendar and tasks and acts on its own.
